open_questions: New Sales-only part, KC06 'Count what they gave': a sheet of the six shilling notes in token softs (one tap adds a note, a ×N badge counts it, a − takes one back) plus 'Type it' for the S03 keypad. It opens from an 'Other amount' glass pill in the They gave label row, because S02 doesn't say where the typed amount is opened from. Once an amount is typed, it shows as the chosen fourth tile. Please approve it so the lead can add it to LANGUAGE.md.

End of flow: neither Sold screen (KC14 cash, KC15 mobile) auto-returns, because a cashier giving change must not lose the screen. Both have 'Back to Today' plus the glass pills Receipt and Sell again. This departs from P22's 4 px return bar, so please confirm.
The Paste chip (KC08) reads the clipboard: the app needs the browser's clipboard permission on the phone.
When nothing is picked yet (KC01), the empty dock leaves out the Cash · Mobile · Bank picker; the lead's S02 board always shows it.
KC11 'Serve the next walk-in': when Ruth answers, Grace needs a push (handoff rule) that brings the waiting sale back.
Counter sales do not count toward Grace's goal (canvas-cast puts the counter in 'the rest'), so the Sold screens show 'Today at the counter' and no goal ring. Please confirm.
'Order in' on a counter sale turns the whole sale into an order (sales.html countertoorder), and links to SL05Order. This is the same word SL13 uses.

Tender rule (as FACTS): the two likely notes above the total (52,000 → 55,000 / 60,000; 203,500 → 205,000 / 210,000). sales.html's ctGivenChoices starts at the next 1,000 (204,000), so the code needs the same rule.
Lead ruling 'asks are navy': KC10's Ask Ruth is now a navy block in the content, beside a white 'Shop price 218,500'. The dock shows a locked slide, 'Ask Ruth first'.
